name: popcorn-vote
description: Fair family movie night voting. Everyone suggests films, gets one vote a week and can save votes up, so a film only one person wants wins eventually too. Ties are settled by a wheel of fortune, and watched films go into a shared rated archive with star ratings. Mobile-first and installable as a PWA. Nine interface languages. Film data, posters and trailers come from TMDB, IMDb ratings through OMDb; both services are free for private use and each needs its own key. Everything is configured in the browser on first start: family PIN, members, both API keys and the languages. No configuration file to edit, no console needed.

paths.name: Appdata
paths.description: Database, downloaded posters and the nightly backups. This is the only thing worth backing up.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port the web interface listens on.

variables.name: TMDB API key
variables.description: Free key from themoviedb.org, used for search, posters, descriptions and trailers. May be left empty here and entered in the browser during first-run setup instead.

variables.name: OMDb API key
variables.description: Free key from omdbapi.com, used for the IMDb rating only. Optional. May also be entered during first-run setup.

variables.name: Time zone
variables.description: Decides when the weekly vote credit is handed out. Use your own zone, for example America/New_York.

variables.name: Family PIN
variables.description: Four digits, shared by the whole family. Leave empty to set it in the browser on first start, which is the recommended way: a PIN entered here is stored in the container template in plain text.

variables.name: Session timeout
variables.description: Seconds without activity before a device has to enter the PIN again. Default is one year, matching the trusted family tablet.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: error, warn, info or debug. Default is info.
